evidence_excerpt: Fix a regression on ROCm where the init-time e_score_correction_bias dtype cast became a no-op, re-introducing a per-layer elementwise kernel on every forward pass.

Add env flags to disable dynamic MXFP4 quant and enable AITER tuned GEMMs for Attention Projection Layers — route unquantized attention GEMMs through AITER's FlyDSL-based tuned GEMM implementations instead of skinny-reduce or hipBLASLt.
Kimi-K2.5 multimodal inference is completely broken because media_placeholder_token_id disagrees with the tokenizer's actual mapping; resolve correct token ID from the tokenizer.
Install libcublas-dev in Dockerfile so FlashInfer's flashinfer_cutedsl MoE backend doesn't fail with cublasLt.h: No such file at JIT-compile.
Fix FlashInferNVLinkOneSidedManager and FlashInferNVLinkTwoSidedManager so MNNVL workspace is sized to the EP group instead of the DP group.
Treat <tool_call> as implicit reasoning end in Qwen3 parser so tool calls are not silently dropped.
When dtype=float16, due to the smaller dynamic range, data overflow can easily occur during GEMM in marlin causing NaN/Inf; dynamically scale the input before GEMM.
Auto-disable DeepGemm for Qwen3.5 on Blackwell — adds a model-type exclusion list checked during config finalization on SM100+, fixing a 12pp accuracy drop.
Adds optional FP8 quantization for ViT encoder attention via the FlashInfer cuDNN backend (new kernel/op support for ViT attn).
Current replica selection in the EPLB fused-MoE router distributes tokens unevenly across replicas; switching hashing implementation fixes the imbalance.
Fix workspace resize leaking reserved GPU memory — moe workspace may double-resident, causing OOM during inference.
Qwen3 MoE model will call gate gemm twice; follow deepseek_v2 pattern using is_internal_router to fix the duplicate gate call.
Allows FP8 models to be run on NVIDIA Thor (SM110) — extends sm100 cutlass kernels to also dispatch on sm110 hardware.

TurboQuant adds online KV cache compression to vLLM's v1 attention backend using PolarQuant for keys and uniform quantization for values, via fused Triton kernels (new attention backend / kernel family).
Replace .weight.shape[0] with sum(output_sizes) — MergedColumnParallelLinear does not expose .weight when using quantization methods, causing AttributeError on Qwen3.5 GDN layers.
Replace concatenate-sentinel-then-argmax with simple sum of valid tokens for accepted token counting in spec decode; eliminates unnecessary memory allocation.

Align is_tma_supported with upstream FLA: TMA is now disabled by default and requires FLA_USE_TMA=1 — vLLM's GDN prefill kernels were taking the TMA path on B200 which is slower and diverges from reference.
Do not shard shared experts weights when sequence parallel is enabled — fixes precision issue for Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next with EP.
Fix input_ids and expert_map args for quark w4a8 gptoss — adds the missing input_ids arg to QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod_OSS.apply_monolithic.
Adds a smoke test for long-context behavior using OpenAI's public openai/mrcr dataset to tests/evals/.
Fix OOM by setting PyTorch max_split_size_mb during model loading — the upgrade from PyTorch 2.9 to 2.10 substantially increased memory fragmentation.
Support limiting thinking tokens and forcing thinking end tokens via logit processors (new sampling/logits-processor feature).
FlashInfer top-k/top-p has better performance compared to Triton's implementation — re-enable FlashInfer sampler by default after the NaN-handling root cause was fixed.

Several quantization methods were failing on ROCm because they weren't registered in the platform's supported_quantization list, even though the underlying kernels already support them — adds them to ROCm's supported quantization allowlist.
Bulk merge of 5 Silo config-only PRs — Pure CSV tuning configs, no code changes — for GLM-4.7, Kimi-K2.5, MiniMax-M2.5, DeepSeek-V3.2.
In ck_moe_stage1, the tmp_out buffer was allocated as (token_num, topk, w1.shape[1]) which is undersized when splitK > 1; fix the Python-side buffer sizing to match the C++ fix.
Add FlyDSL a4w4 MoE kernel implementation with preshuffle pipeline optimization, plus updated DeepSeek-V3 fp4 MoE tuning.
SGLang crashes when serving Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4 (384 experts) for long sequences — moe_fused_gate requires num_experts to be a power of 2; update topk dispatch to handle non-power-of-2 experts.
Create script to benchmark attention kernels with shapes of LLM models — comprehensive benchmarking routine for Triton attention kernels.
Introduced three new JSON configuration files for GEMM operations on gfx942 for DSKR1 (A8W8 BLOCKSCALE shapes).
dsv3 blockscale gemm config in mi300 — model_configs/a8w8_blockscale_tuned_gemm_ds_v3.csv update.
Re-tuned BF16 GEMM configs for GPT-OSS, DSV3, Kimi-K2 with FlyDSL competing alongside ASM/hipBLASLt/Triton; added new BF16 GEMM tuned configs for Llama 70B/405B/Qwen 32B.
Remove cu=80 configs and update dsv3 bpreshuffle configs — both cu=80 and cu=256 configs were generated, the later overwrote the first causing wrong kernel selection on mi355.
Add tuned GEMM/MoE configs for DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4 on MI355X (cu_num=256): a8w8_bpreshuffle, a4w4_blockscale, fp4 FusedMoE, bf16 N=256,K=7168.
Gemm & moe tunning for DeepSeek-R1 in InferenceX FP4 case — tune gemm and fmoe stage2 for dsv3 EP8 fp4 decode.
Add blockPerCu support for CKTile GEMMs and CKTile MOE tuning — extends tuning search space and adds CKTile to MOE tuner with new model_configs csvs for ds_v3 and qwen3_235b.
Replace the generic vLLM benchmark matrix with explicit top-priority lanes for gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek-R1-0528, and Kimi-K2.5 in CI workflow.
Re-tuned the 2-stage fused MoE GEMM kernel selection for the Kimi-K2 model with MXFP4 — Kimik2-Thinking-MXFP4 e2e runs not picking performant MOE1 kernels.
Retune Kimi configs: Add the third expert group with inter_dim=385, topk=9 for full MoE configuration coverage; fix fallback config overwrite bug in incremental tuning.
Add A4W4 blockscale GEMM tuned configs and fused_moe tuned configs for Kimi-K2.5 on MI355X.
Special path for moe ptpc fp8, batch 1~32 — further optimize Qwen3.5 397B FP8 PTPC MOE in decoding for batch 1-32 with FP8 weight decompression, gated by AITER_MOE_SMALL_BATCH=1.
Introduce asm fmoe kernels that do not require bf16->fp8 quantization — for qwen3-next model in TP4 mode there is no assembly kernel that can match h_dim=128.
The type annotation bool was incorrect for moe_sorting_dispatch_policy — with bool, dispatch_policy=2 becomes True (1), silently losing intended policy; change to int.
Introduce 16x128 fused moe kernel with weights prefetch — about 10% faster than CK kernel for qwen3-next shapes for tokens 1,2,4.
1-stage fused allreduce+RMSNorm kernel produces numerically different residual outputs vs unfused path, causing -2.6pp on GSM8K; add bf16 round-trip after f32 allreduce.
Fix use after free issue in moe_sorting_fwd by declaring torch::Tensor ws outside curly braces.
16x256 kernel — extension of 16x128 which can be better with certain inputs; new asm fmoe kernel binary for qwen3-next.
CKTile blockscale GEMM host wrapper hardcoded leading-dimension strides causing wrong memory offsets and silently wrong output for padded FP8 weight tensors; read strides from tensor metadata.
Add 32x128 and 64x128 asm kernels to support qwen3-next TP4 — clear double-digit benefit over CK kernels with token count > 32.
Updated the gfx950-FF-A16W16-fused.json config by changing num_stages from 2 to 1 for the affected small-M bucket — tuning config fix for irregular shapes with async copy enabled.
Fix 2-stage fused_allreduce_rmsnorm memory ordering — can return wrong results on ROCm once per-rank volume crosses ~1.2 MB at TP=8.
Add StreamLLM sink token support for batch_prefill pipeline — promotes kHasSink_ to a real template parameter enabling _sink/_nsink kernel variant codegen.
Fix some benchmark scripts so that they generate the output CSVs — bug affecting Triton-based MoE GEMM benchmarks.
Generalize the GDN per-request state decoupling into a complete model-agnostic KV cache abstraction owned by the AttentionMetadataBuilder hierarchy — ModelRunner net: -526 LOC.
PD disaggregation — new sequence status WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS, deferred block deallocation, connector metadata per batch for prefill/decode disaggregation.
DeepSeek v3.2: add sparse prefill mla and fix indexer rope — adds new sparse-MLA prefill kernel path.
Update GLM-5.md to refer to atom-dev docker container — docs change.
TP4 benchmark results for DeepSeek-R1-0528 were not visible in the benchmark dashboard; add explicit dashboard_model names for the two TP4 cases.
Add a step-by-step guide for using Hermes Agent with ATOM as the local inference backend.
Refactor OpenAI server with tool calling, reasoning, and debug logging — splits monolithic openai_server.py into focused modules with new tool calling and reasoning content separation.
Upgrade vLLM to 0.19.0 commit 2a6994 — plugin upgrade with no new accuracy failures.

Both Kimi-K2-Thinking-MXFP4 and Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4 now support fp4 quantization of shared experts, thus shared experts can be fused — remove ATOM_DUAL_STREAM_MOE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=0 env var from oot test script.
Update the recipe for Kimi-K2 and Kimi-K2.5 — recipe markdown change.
Fix Qwen3.5 RoPE validation ignore_keys_at_rope_validation type — newer transformers treats this field as a set, causing TypeError.
Add support for Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-Next to ATOM-plugined SGLang — extends SGLang plugin path so Qwen3-next and Qwen3.5 model families are usable.
Fix qwen3.5 fp8 functionality and accuracy issue — fix both fp8 and bf16 qwen3.5 moe model.
Improve blog-atom-vllm-plugin.md clarity, completeness, and references — blog markdown review.
Phase 2: replace dict-style quant_config access with LayerQuantConfig — converts all other models to use the same structured quantization config instead of a dict.
Adds Qwen3.5 model support to ATOM, including both dense and MoE variants — implementation leverages ATOM's vLLM plugin mode and ATOM's optimized kernels for linear attention (GatedDeltaNet) layers.
Optimize qwen3 next inplace copy — layernorm and triton_gemma_rmsnorm changes for in-place copy optimization.
Refine the atom-vllm benchmark and add ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GDR for qwen3 next model — env var enables FlyDSL GDR routing for Qwen3-Next benchmarks.
Add DualRMSNorm fused Q/K RMSNorm Triton kernel wrapper and QKVGParallelLinear deinterleaver for Qwen3-next.
Fix dashboard regression detection, MTP parsing, TP/GPU display — false-positive regression alerts when throughput improved.
Refactors and optimizes attention metadata — 1% to 2% performance improvement on gpt-oss-120b in low concurrency.
Support TBO (two-batch overlap) in ATOM with dp attn + mori — adds --enable-tbo and --all2all-backend low-latency.
Add Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-MXFP4-Preview to the ATOM nightly benchmark pipeline — model already implemented and registered, this only adds it to the benchmark config.
Add contiguous to tensor_model_parallel_fused_allreduce_rmsnorm because it does not support non-contiguous input — title says 'remove rmsnorm allreduce fusion in gpt-oss'.
Fix tp8 accuracy for gpt-oss — add contiguous before all reduce; remove rms+allreduce fused op because aiter ops is not supported.
Load quark gpt_oss 120b wmxfp4 afp8 — adds loader/moe support for amd/gpt-oss-120b-w-mxfp4-a-fp8 quantization variant.
